name: Platinic-Tor
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait massive canyon systems, and everything the light never reaches.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
